in_sanskrit.name: सुहसिनी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root words 'su' (good, auspicious) and 'hasini' (shining, beautiful, pleasing), the name Suhasini translates to one who is auspicious, blessed, prosperous, and fortunate.

in_marathi.name: Suhasini
